phase_name: App/Tests Implementation Start Pre-Launch Final ABORT Conditions Design
phase_japanese_name: app/tests 実装開始直前の最終ABORT条件設計
purpose: Design final ABORT conditions that must be checked immediately before implementation-start execution, preventing accidental or unsafe transition from design-only state to code implementation

ab1_gate_breakdown.trigger: Any of the 5 minimum GO conditions becomes false at final pre-launch check
ab1_gate_breakdown.example: dual_gate regressed to LOCKED after earlier evaluation

ab2_evidence_or_signature_invalid.trigger: Phase 20-4 lock verification fail or final authority signature invalid/expired/revoked

ab3_state_invariant_violation.trigger: Unexpected state drift or unauthorized status change detected

ab5_environment_or_scope_mismatch.trigger: Implementation target scope differs from authorized scope or environment changed critically

scope_2_pre_launch_abort_checklist.description: Immediate pre-launch checklist run right before any implementation task creation

check_5.question: human final approval signature valid and active ?

check_6.question: Phase 20-4 evidence lock checks TD1-TD4 all pass ?

check_7.question: No open RC/NO-GO/HALT items from Phase 20-5 ?

check_8.question: Authorized implementation scope matches requested scope ?

step_3_notify.action: Notify responsible authority and security reviewer

routes.AB1: Re-evaluate Phase 20-3 with latest measurement state
routes.AB2: Restore evidence/signature validity then rerun Phase 20-4 checks
routes.AB5: Re-authorize correct scope and rerun pre-launch checks

step_5_resume_condition.action: Resume consideration only after all PL1-PL8 checks are PASS in a fresh run

precedence: AB3 (state invariant violation) has highest priority and implies HALT
AB2 (evidence/signature invalid) overrides any tentative GO
Any single failed PL check forces ABORT
Only full PL1-PL8 PASS allows transition to implementation-start execution
scope_4_precedence_and_final_rule.final_rule: In current design-only state, pre-launch outcome remains ABORT/NO_GO by default until actual measurements and approvals satisfy all conditions

phase_20_6_completion_criteria: No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
